name: Krusch-FS MCP
description: Local OS filesystem and optional SSH-fleet page-anchored memory MCP server (kruschdev/krusch-fs-mcp v0.3.1) with SHA-256 PageMemory drift checks and automatic .env secret-value redaction. Indexed page-tree, glob locate, and bounded page reads inherit Guard policy; hybrid search, page memory writes, and incremental local/SSH sync require review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use krusch_fs_locate, krusch_fs_page_tree, and krusch_fs_read_page to inspect already-indexed pages without triggering filesystem crawls or SSH fleet syncs.
Keep krusch_fs_sync and krusch_fs_remember_on_page on Review: sync crawls configured local or SSH-reachable paths into fs_memory.db, and remember_on_page writes durable notes.
